description: This is a Makefile defining kernel modules for the OpenWrt project, specifically for the Airoha target platform. It includes definitions for I2C and PWM kernel modules tailored for the Airoha AN7581 hardware.

methods.name: KernelPackage/i2c-an7581
methods.description: Defines kernel module parameters and dependencies for the Airoha I2C controller.

methods.name: KernelPackage/pwm-an7581
methods.description: Defines kernel module parameters and dependencies for the Airoha PWM controller.
